frequency_question: How often does the Department of Education complete a full revocation of an accrediting agency's recognition within a 4-month (131-day) period?
membership_rule: Includes all formal proceedings initiated by the U.S. Department of Education to terminate the recognition of a national accrediting agency. Excludes voluntary withdrawals or renewals.
provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 2 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: The population of full revocations is extremely small; the process is structurally designed to exceed 131 days.
known_gaps: Lack of historical instances of rapid revocation; the APA process is inherently slow.
skeleton: Administrative Procedure Act (APA) requirements for notice, comment, and administrative review.
multiplier: Notice (30-60 days) + Comment period (30-60 days) + Final determination (30-60 days) + Administrative appeal (60+ days).
validity_reason: The Administrative Procedure Act and Department of Education regulations governing recognition are stable and unlikely to change significantly in the next two years.
